verdict: The question is one a viewer of the Commission on Spending would click on and the claims are the ones the public actually makes: payback time, battery failure, insurance, tyres, resale and charging cost. Each is decidable by the named datasets or studies rather than by opinion. The three sources I opened exist and make the claims attributed to them. The overlap note is honest: heat pumps shares the tariff question only. The weakest claim is resale value, where the data moves quickly and a study may be out of date by the time of publication.
concerns: Resale value data moves quickly; the story should date its figures.
The maintenance claim may be too settled to carry a story on its own.
